description: A check-your-inbox screen after sign-up, with open mail, resend and change-address actions.
overview: The screen shows the address the link was sent to and a link to change it. The `BottomBar` has an Open Mail `Button` and a Resend `Button` that disables itself for a 45-second countdown. Opening mail shows a verified confirmation in this sample.
usage: Replace `EMAIL` with the user's address. Use `onOpenMail` to open the mail app and `onChangeAddress` to go back to the email field.
